simplyswordsoverhaul_logout_dash_restore.conversion: Gameplay fix, off by default. MixinSquared @TargetHandler injections into Simply Swords Overhaul's MixinWhisperwindSword / MixinStormsEdgeSword / MixinEmberlashSword.modifyUseMethod handlers (merged into the Simply Swords items' use): MixinExtras @WrapOperation on their Scheduler.schedule calls hands each task to SsoDash.task (the same task, wrapped for a per-player session: tasks pending, whether gravity is off because Simply Swords Overhaul's own code turned it off), and on their Player.setNoGravity calls reports the change to SsoDash.gravity; @Inject at RETURN of Scheduler.<clinit> registers PlayerLoggedOutEvent and ServerStoppedEvent listeners. At logout, for a player with dash tasks pending: gravity back on if the dash turned it off, Whisperwind's dashing and kill flags removed and the hit list dropped when the dashing flag is set; the remaining tasks do nothing. Runtime flag simplyswordsoverhaulLogoutDashRestore. Helpers bons.furious.patch.simplyswordsoverhaul_coo49.SsoDash, SsoMaps.
simplyswordsoverhaul_logout_dash_restore.license: Simply Swords Overhaul (MIT): no code carried; the session bookkeeping and the logout listener are ours. Simply Swords (Timefall Development License): only targeted.

simplyswordsoverhaul_molten_edge_buff_re.conversion: Trade-off, off by default. MixinSquared @TargetHandler + MixinExtras @WrapOperation on the three Player.addEffect calls of Simply Swords Overhaul's MixinMoltenEdgeSword.modifyInventoryTick handler (merged into MoltenEdgeSwordItem.inventoryTick): SsoMoltenEdge leaves a call out while the player already has that effect at the same amplifier and ambient / visible / icon flags with more than 80 ticks left; anything else runs as shipped. The difference: the sword's buff timers run between 80 and 100 ticks instead of staying at 100, so after the sword is put away or the level drops a buff mostly ends up to 20 ticks sooner (measured: 1,278 of 1,282 stretches with another level), after several level changes within a few seconds up to 100 ticks sooner, and now and then a lower level that vanilla's hidden-effect chain drops stays on; held at one level the buffs are the same. Runtime flag simplyswordsoverhaulMoltenEdgeBuffRefresh. Helper bons.furious.patch.simplyswordsoverhaul_coo49.SsoMoltenEdge.
